blockingIssues.description: Ignore rules leak across sibling directories because directory-scoped ignore state is pushed but not popped during recursion unwind, causing baseline parity failures.
`-r` cannot override `-n` (last-flag semantics mismatch): recurse intent is parsed but not honored by traversal logic.
Conflicting multiline flags do not follow baseline last-wins behavior; `--nomultiline --multiline` still runs nomultiline path.
Binary-enabled mode short-circuits output handling, so `--search-binary` with `-c`/`-l` prints generic binary-match text instead of baseline-compatible count/list outputs.
`--max-count` diagnostics diverge under invert-match scenarios because max-count hit logic is derived from reportable-line counting instead of baseline-compatible match-cap semantics.
